title: Quaint Garlicky British Sausages Toad In The Hole
description: A hearty British dish featuring garlicky sausages and a cheese-pull effect, perfect for a hangover cure, with the added flavors of dill and kombu-cold-extract, made in an ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly way, this toad-in-the-hole is sure to satisfy. The combination of ingredients provides a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper to make the batter.
Add the chopped dill and kombu-cold-extract to the batter and mix well.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlicky Cornish sausages to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Place the cooked sausages into the batter, leaving space between each sausage.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the sausages and batter.
Bake the toad-in-the-hole in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the batter is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
